headlines.text: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there. Some of the most dramatic footage from the deadly flash flooding is hidden from public view in China.

Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne. Mourners gather outside the palace as royals, politicians and citizens remember a beloved king, whose son has adopted the family motto "all for norway".
Oslo mayor calls off wedding ceremony after death of Norway's king. Anne Lindboe, the mayor of Norway's capital, had planned to marry her fiance on Friday.
Russia ramps up rhetoric but wants to avoid war with Nato, Western officials say. But they say Moscow will likely continue its "hybrid activity" against Nato members, short of direct military action.
Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE. The British citizen, who lives and works in the US, has supported Trump and ICE agents in the past.
Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers, mayor says. Kai Wegner says the German capital and city-state would not cave in to a ransom demand for data stolen in a cyber-attack.
Thieves steal 600-diamond necklace from Vienna museum in broad daylight. Police are hunting two suspects they believe bought a ticket for the exhibition to get at the jewellery.
Greenland says findings on genocide allegation not final. Experts examined the use of forced contraception on the Inuit community during the 1960s and 70s.
Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues. A group of migrants is accused of throwing stones at a military vehicle, while some locals set fire to their camps on the beach.
World's youngest reigning traditional monarch dies aged 34. King Oyo ascended to the throne of Uganda's Tooro kingdom when he was just three years old.
US plans to cut off military aid to key Middle East ally, BBC told. Iraqi Kurdistan fears the Trump administration's plan will make the region more vulnerable to further attacks from Iran.
Two-year curfew lifted in Sudan's capital. The military authorities retook control of the city 18 months ago, but the conflict continues elsewhere.
Shootings surge as drug gangs torment Brussels. This year alone there have been more than 65 shootings in the Belgian capital, as drug crime soars.
Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America. Canada has rejected the new name of the lake, which straddles both countries, as their row deepens.
Dutch court sentences man to life over Rwanda genocide. The court in The Hague convicted the 66-year-old of war crimes and the crime of genocide.
Kenyan police fire tear gas at Nairobi protest against import duty hike. Traders frustrated by more than $5,000 duty hike they say will hurt small businesses.
The two types of Israeli settlers. Israeli settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank isn’t just driven by ideology, but also by economic incentives.
LIVE: Crystal Palace vs Manchester City – Premier League. Live coverage and text updates from our commentary stream as Erling Haaland will look to fire City to consecutive wins.
6 months of war on Iran. The US-Israeli war on Iran has reached the six-month mark, with no sign of slowing down.
Nepali families pray for miracles with relatives missing after flood. At a Kathmandu hospital, families peer at lists of those who are critical, dead — or have been released.
Can Trump really rename Lake Ontario, ‘Lake America’?. Amid tariff war with Canada, Trump has signed an executive order renaming the shared lake.
Oneness or Hindu supremacy? RSS chief Bhagwat’s secretive New York hosts. RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat is scheduled to speak at an event in New York on Saturday.

Europa League draw: Bournemouth, Sunderland get glamour ties with AC Milan. Teams playing in UEFA's Europa League and Conference League find out their opponents as league phase draws made.
Qatar pledges support for efforts to end Libya’s political division. Qatari minister meets army chief amid efforts to bridge longstanding political divisions in Libya.
Dutch court hands life sentence to Rwandan man for genocide role. Eugene N. was convicted for his part in a massacre at a stadium in which 3,000 Tutsis were slaughtered.
US ICE agency to spend $16.7m on electric shock gloves. The much-criticised immigration agency has agreed a contract for 6,000 pairs of gloves that will deliver painful shocks.
Narrow escape for woman as Russian drone hits residential area. Video shows the moment a Russian attack hit a parking lot near Ukraine’s capital.
After six months of war, what have US, Iran gained and lost?. Many of the US president's goals remain unfulfilled, despite claims of victory.

Broncos coach Sean Payton buries Geoff Schwartz after analyst butchers Bo Nix's downfield game. Sean Payton fired back at analyst Geoff Schwartz after his claim that Bo Nix doesn't push the ball downfield was corrected by deep-ball stats.

Dodgers owner Mark Walter denies reports, says team payroll is supported by revenue: 'There has been no fraud'. TWG Global denies fraud allegations in a new statement, saying no one has been harmed and that the Los Angeles Dodgers have top revenue in baseball.
